history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration take all measures necessary to expedite the development of the country common premises plan at the country level and ensure that the resource mobilization plan and the impact and prioritizing analyses are finished as planned in accordance with the Business Innovations Group’s annual workplan.
history.administration_response: In line with the recommendation of the Board, the Task Team on Common Premises, for which the Development Coordination Office is the secretariat, partnered with a Global Real estate team which was to identify six country- locations with the highest potential for efficiencies. The project was concluded with analysis and recommendations in September 2023, which means that the Development Coordination Office is no longer responsible. Resource mobilization for implementation of the recommendations is the full responsibility of the entities. The Development Coordination Office does not manage any capital asset funds. The Development Coordination Office therefore requests the Board to close this recommendation, as “support to improve the process” has been achieved.
history.board_assessment: Given that the common premises real estate analysis was conducted in 2023 and country locations with the highest potential for efficiencies were identified, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
